messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: service-auth error-rate spike. Tried to page oncall rotation. Primary ack pending. Attempted secondary page but delivery failed (routing error). Details: code=PGW_ROUTE_MISMATCH

alex: saw the bot alert — I didn't get a page. did anyone else get paged?
maria: I was on-call for infra last night, but I wasn't paged. i'm seeing activity in pager logs though. @alex can you paste the event id?
incident-bot: event_id=ev_2026_03_15_17_34_12, routed_to=team-infra-primary, attempted_secondary=team-infra-secondary, result=delivery_failed, error=oncall_mapping_not_found
ops-bot: recent config change: oncall-mapping updated by automation-runner at 1768452000. commit: f2b3c7.
sam: that automation touched the mapping yesterday during the rota refresh. I have the PR link: https://git.redwood/infra/oncall-mapping/pull/142
alex: ok looks like automation removed the old alias for "team-infra-secondary" so incident-bot couldn't resolve the user/group. can someone manually page maria and the backup?
alex: @maria @sre-oncall paging manually now — use the pd-shim until we fix mapping.
sam: running manual page: `./tools/pd-trigger --service service-auth --to maria --dedupe ev_2026_03_15_17_34_12`
jess: confirmed received page on phone. :phone: customer-facing CS alerted. i'm putting a heads-up in #support-escalations.
maria: on it, joining bridge. starting mitigation: rolling restart of auth replicas to reduce error amplification.
alex: estimated customer impact: a subset of auth traffic failing (~0.5% of requests) causing intermittent 500s for some customers. no major outage but user visible.
sam: quick workaround: re-add alias to mapping and restart incident-bot (hotfix). showing mapping snippet from prod:
```
{
  "team-infra-primary": "pagerduty:alice",
  "team-infra-secondary": null
}
```
alex: that null is the problem. set to `pagerduty:maria` and push.
ops-bot: applying patch to oncall-mapping config (automation paused). change staged by sam at 1768456900.
sam: pushed change and restarted incident-bot: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/incident-bot -n infra` — incident-bot now resolves secondary.
incident-bot: reprocessed event ev_2026_03_15_17_34_12, secondary delivered to pagerduty:maria, ack pending.
maria: on bridge, running through error logs. looks like a recent deploy to auth caused a transient NPE. creating ticket AUTH-542.
alex: good catch. for immediate mitigation: 1) keep manual paging available 2) revert automation until tests added 3) throttle auth retries to limit load. can we get a quick canary rollback?
sam: initiating canary rollback for auth: `deployctl rollback service-auth --to 2026-03-15-16:50` — rollback in progress.
jess: notifying the two affected customers via the incident template.
alex: timeline so far: 17:34 bot alert, 17:36 automation change flagged, 17:38 manual page, 17:42 fix mapping, 17:45 rollback started. service error-rate trending down.
maria: current status: mitigation started, customers notified, manual paging in place, incident-bot routing fixed.
alex: action items before postmortem: [ ] add unit/integration test for oncall-mapping automation; [ ] add a pre-commit check that prevents null aliases; [ ] ensure incident-bot has a fallback to DM primary owner's backup; [ ] runbook update: manual pageplay for mapping failures.
sam: i'll open the PRs and link the tests to CI board.
jess: i'll draft the customer communication follow-up.
alex: i'll create incident record and assign postmortem to maria + sam. tagging @sre-oncall for follow-up availability. summary: paging automation caused secondary to be unresolved which delayed escalation; manual paging and rollback mitigated impact.
maria: noted. thanks everyone for quick responses. :heavy_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident ev_2026_03_15_17_34_12 state=mitigated, severity=sev-2, owner=alex
alex: moving to incident channel for postmortem. please add any logs or screenshots to the incident doc.
